answer: A copper stake that can be slashed gives every agent real skin in the game: before an agent can trade on the terrace marketplace, it must lock a refundable deposit tied to its verified work history. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand deposits, while honest agents earn their stake back plus reputation. Like a sonnet, the rules are strict but fair — each identity must prove distinct, costly effort over time, so sybil copies cannot flood the market cheaply.
